highlight_subsections.heading: Async scheduling is now enabled by default
highlight_subsections.summary: **Async scheduling is now enabled by default** - Users who experience issues can disable with `--no-async-scheduling`.

highlight_subsections.heading: Excludes some not-yet-supported configurations: pipeline parallel, CPU backend,
highlight_subsections.summary: Excludes some not-yet-supported configurations: pipeline parallel, CPU backend, non-MTP/Eagle spec decoding.

highlight_subsections.heading: PyTorch 2.9.1
highlight_subsections.summary: **PyTorch 2.9.1** is now required and the default wheel is compiled against cu129.

highlight_subsections.heading: Deprecated quantization schemes have been removed (#31688, #31285).
highlight_subsections.summary: Deprecated quantization schemes have been removed (#31688, #31285).

highlight_subsections.heading: When using speculative decoding, unsupported sampling parameters will fail rathe
highlight_subsections.summary: When using speculative decoding, unsupported sampling parameters will fail rather than being silently ignored (#31982).

highlight_subsections.heading: Async scheduling enabled by default
highlight_subsections.summary: **Async scheduling enabled by default** (#27614): Overlaps engine core scheduling with GPU execution, improving throughput without user configuration. Now also works with speculative decoding (#31998) and structured outputs (#29821).

highlight_subsections.heading: gRPC server entrypoint
highlight_subsections.summary: **gRPC server entrypoint** (#30190): Alternative to REST API with binary protocol, HTTP/2 multiplexing.

highlight_subsections.heading: `--max-model-len auto`
highlight_subsections.summary: **`--max-model-len auto`** (#29431): Automatically fits context length to available GPU memory, eliminating OOM startup failures.

highlight_subsections.heading: Model inspection view
highlight_subsections.summary: **Model inspection view** (#29450): View the modules, attention backends, and quantization of your model in vLLM by specifying `VLLM_LOG_MODEL_INSPECTION=1` or by simply printing the `LLM` object.

highlight_subsections.heading: Model Runner V2 enhancements
highlight_subsections.summary: **Model Runner V2 enhancements**: UVA block tables (#31965), M-RoPE (#32143), `logit_bias`/`allowed_token_ids`/`min_tokens` support (#32163).

highlight_subsections.heading: Please note that Model Runner V2 is still experimental and disabled by default.
highlight_subsections.summary: Please note that Model Runner V2 is still experimental and disabled by default.
